note: Name substrings and Bluetooth SIG company identifiers used as hints. A name match is not proof. Manufacturer 0x004C (Apple) and 0x0075 (Samsung) are official company IDs and also appear on phones; they are treated as a weak mixed signal unless the advertised name looks like a camera or a tracker.
